The orcs of Ulderek's Rock are preparing for war and the guard {npc:Baxter}, at the door of Thais castle, needs volunteers. You can repair outposts, set fire to ballistas, catapults and siege towers and spy on the orcs' war plans. Each task gives 1000 experience (2000 at the top rank) and, as you collect "achievements", you rise in rank up to **War Hero**, with an experience bonus at each promotion.
